notes.title: 🍄 MARCH OF SHROOMS IS NOW LIVE! 🍄
notes.content:
March of Shrooms is now live!!
To celebrate we've got a brand new trailer to share 
[previewyoutube=itdoKFYjPyQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Embark on a colossal adventure with the tiniest shroom to unite shroomkind before the impending storm wipes away the joyous civilization of the Shroomy Isles! March of Shrooms isn't just a game; it's a vibrant, effervescent world brimming with mysteries, bubbles, and, of course, cheery shrooms.

🌈 Key Features:

Hop across levels with personalities and gameplay quirks that will keep you on your myc—er, feet!
Each chapter introduces fresh environments, challenges, and buffs. Replay levels on higher difficulties to earn rare items, face new encounters, and unlock upgrades for the tiny shroom's big village.

🎖️Easy to Learn, Difficult to Master:
Designed for casual and hardcore players alike, March of Shrooms is a game where you fight the greedy shrooms, not the keyboard. Enjoy a simple, flexible control scheme on both controllers or mouse and keyboard. Choose your Brand™ and color the platoon to match your mood!

Play March of Shrooms Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2091410/March_of_Shrooms/

🌟 Join the Shroomvolution! 🌟

Your commitment holds mighty power! If you'd like to help, here's how:

Spread the Word: Join the Shroomvolution by sharing the game with your family, friends, and beloved streamers.

Harness the Power of Reviews:  After spending some time battling the storms, consider leaving us a review on Steam, guiding future players and helping refine the game.

Social Media Squad: Share your tales and adventures on social media using #MarchOfShrooms! 

But, no pressure! I'm genuinely thrilled to have you here, whether you're conversing about the game on Steam, in the Discord, or ushering in a new age of shroomkind by playing the game. Thank you to everyone who has been following along, and supporting the development of the game. Your morel support has meant the world to me! 𓍊𓋼𓍊𓋼𓍊

If you come across any bugs or have valuable feedback, I'd love to hear from you! You can head to our Discussion Forum here on Steam called Bug Reports to report any bugs or you can join the official Discord community. 

🍄 Let the March of the Shrooms Begin! 🍄

notes.title: 🍄Countdown Alert: March of Shrooms Launches Monday Nov. 13th!!
notes.content:
🍄 The Final Countdown Has Begun! 🕒✨

On 11/13/2023 5PM EST you can join the shroomvolution!

🌈 Get ready to lead a crowd of adorable mushrooms in this frenetic, cheery crowd brawler, chronicling the tiny shroom's epic odyssey to unite shroomkind against the coming storm!🌈 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/dab35831476ed7afabf9f25e3357cc80d63bc845.gif

Punch your way to unity, happiness, and berries for everyone through a vibrant, effervescent world, full of mysteries, bubbles, and, of course, shrooms!

   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/37e9bb95dca6c447b3a1bc480b1aa36b8a9e8779.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/0eaad8e29c5f912e0b443582d5c8e445a91cf49e.gif

Choose from over 40 distinct shroom species, each with special looks and skills.
Command 30+ shrooms as the head of the entire platoon!
Customize your shrooms for brawling, forming squads with unique orders, sizes, and purposes.
Brawl across hand-crafted levels each with their own personalities and gameplay quirks that will keep you on your myc--er, feet.
Every chapter is a brand new set of levels, with fresh environments, challenges, and buffs. Floating upgrades, explosive chains, and of course, tons of berries to collect.
Replay levels on higher difficulties to earn rare items, face completely new encounters, and unlock new upgrades for the tiny shroom's big village.

AND MORE AWAITS YOU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/36b70a46d4cb12f8eb6b0efaca5f08a7475a3a34.gif


Don't miss out on the adventure of a lifetime! Wishlist March of Shrooms now and be the first to know when the game launches. 📆🔔

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2091410/March_of_Shrooms/

We can’t wait for you all to brawl across the floating islands. 

Until Monday Shroom Commanders!

notes.title: July Update!
notes.content:
Hi Shroom Commanders!

The shroomvolution looms ever closer, and we have more troops ready to volunteer!

Let’s meet the new recruits!

This is Tito! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/ff5c9cb3221fd57b5c5732b7014d5e8abcc39e2b.gif

Tito shrooms are hardy defender shrooms that generates a small wall of spores to defend their comrades.

Tito shrooms usually spend their time helping other shrooms maintain and build their houses. Here’s Tito’s own home!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/2b5a6d7ad8b1ef0d0c8d0f2d37f8db17892f75db.gif

The spores from a Tito shrooms are extremely hard and durable and work well as building bricks. Thanks Tito!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/ff759092853d6e721c335bb7a78d597ec0056ce3.gif

Poofi is reporting in! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/287a48d1ab874024d367e4ffb6a14eac7974d2cc.gif

Poofi shrooms are extremely powerful and are capable of launching a long blast of star-shaped spores at any enemy that dares to get too close.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/9485ac60ad62150113830940d77e84644ae5ec8c.gif
When not in battle, Poofi shrooms are lazy shrooms that lie around the village. Sometimes other shrooms hop on top and use Poofi shrooms as resting spots and beds when they’re off-duty.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/cd9ed027cd7a9a577e33e4bee6c495f26c7fa5e1.gif

We’ve also found a new medic along our adventures! Let’s knock on Mami’s door.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/0bc444f4126653f8616d59cf23f914136bdf1b69.gif
Mami shrooms are delicate support shrooms that focus on supporting their allies with healing spores.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/6ba2859d88f79307049cc85dc4ad47272523cddd.gif

When not in battle Mami shrooms spend their time cleaning the Shroomy Village and napping under logs. What a fanciful life!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/6a090d54d2934ef54009aca428f0580d5e96d238.gif

Those are all the new recruits (for now)! 

If you’d like to learn more about March of Shrooms, don’t forget to join our Discord and follow us on our social media!

Thank you for your support, Shroom Commanders, and we’ll see you in the next update!

notes.title: January Update!
notes.content:
Hello Shroom Commanders!

Commander, I received a report today - here are some more shrooms that are eager to join up!

For our damage dealers, our friend the Bata shroom would love to volunteer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/22dff4e0ff16d4e0f4d03719158452751b1e7d3c.gif

Bata shrooms have an explosive personality to say the least, not a day goes on without at least an explosion and a firework or two around the Bata shrooms! 

In their spare time they like to compete amongst each other to see which shroom can make the biggest spore explosion! (Don’t worry - their homes are fireproof!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/aabb11292d4468b88ea9e07e146c9904e446b7c8.gif

Bata shrooms can pop off their cap (and quickly grow another one) that are filled with spores, these caps detonate and deal massive damage after a short delay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/78d0d0cb420aa4c7c870d243a7a3d02802a64ea3.gif

While Bata shrooms love to do damage, our friends the Lilli shrooms are…pretty much the opposite.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/a723a830ac02b316a709f3d91bc530f821ea9634.gif

Lilli shrooms are the friendliest of all shrooms. They love to make berry tea for all their friends and wherever they go, they like to decorate all the mushroom homes with puffy clouds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/fe729d7579e4d3c9fd7f8b8b4ae7cb438af1d1b9.gif

Lilli shrooms can create fluffy healing clouds that reinvigorate and heal all the allied shrooms that are in the area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/0cb2f87491eb2080c9304c0d4b158f79ec3bd16c.gif

Lilli would love to sign up as one of your platoon’s healers!

These are our current recruits, Commander, but I heard there’s more on the way. We’ll give you an update once those recruits reach our desks!

Thank you for all of your support during development! If you’d like to learn more about March of Shrooms, don’t forget to join our Discord!

notes.title: November Update!
notes.content:
Hi Shroom Commanders!

Are you ready to lead the shroomvolution?

Of course you are!

Let us show you some of our shrooms that are eager to join your platoon!
This is Splendid, ready to hop into your heart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/e06f49c8f83241619aece30cde17697cfb071a03.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/78ce04cf8c4aab9121449a658947a0fb9e9d8be4.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/9367bd3add467e184c778907acd23db1b25225ea.gif

Splendid extend their umbrellas and temporarily increase their defense against attacks from above while defending any allied mushrooms underneath! With a variety of moves, they will for sure be an amazing defense platoon member.

This is Jellyspot! Jellyspot would also love to apply to be part of your platoon. Look at those moves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/002e8d2b5689c50cf517c226092cba3362ab07ab.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/8ada6da357babb2acb1a8565d3d5722bbf69d9ea.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/21131179c6ddc74b0197c37cb27a7ab522488afb.gif 

Jellyspot creates a tiny puff of spores that spread around it that damages nearby hostile shrooms. They hope you’ll accept their application!

The last potential member we’d like to introduce is Goblet! Goblet would like to apply to be your platoon’s medic. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/412f363a549916dc961e3a674efda3be00c3ef51.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/ed0da55f7441eae000575ef3c209441861761f39.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42853839/315b53f042c6add1462707b9bea75c19be793578.gif

Using a bouncy healing bubble, Goblet heals any allied mushroom it touches. The bubble bounces 3 times after every contact! Goblet promises to be the best support they can be for your platoon!

Speaking of support, thank YOU for all of your support during development!
